Job description

For our pioneering Space Projects, Airbus Defence and Space is looking for an

Intern in Requirements Management of Space Projects (satellites, instruments, equipments) in Friedrichshafen (d/f/m)

You are enrolled in an engineering study looking for an internship position and want to get to know the work of a Requirements Manager (d/f/m)?

- Location: Friedrichshafen
- Start: September 2026
- Duration: 6 months

Our departments provide services to a multitude of cutting edge space projects including product data management, change management and support to verification and validation. We are an enabler for all disciplines within a project, especially system engineering responsible to ensure consistency between product definition, development and manufacturing. We are managing a large number of stakeholders and operate in a complex international environment.

This sounds interesting to you? Then apply now! We look forward to you supporting us in the teams Configuration and Change Management, Data Management & Operations as an intern (d/f/m).

Your location

At the Airbus site in Friedrichshafen you will be working on innovation where others spend their holidays. Enjoy panoramic views of Lake Constance while having lunch in our canteen. And after work, join one of our many corporate sports groups to go running, sailing or skiing.

Your benefits

- Attractive salary and work-life balance with a 35-hour week (flexitime).
- International environment with the opportunity to network globally.
- Work with modern/diversified technologies.
- At Airbus, we see you as a valuable team member and you are not hired to brew coffee, instead you are in close contact with the interfaces and are part of our weekly team meetings.
- Opportunity to participate in the Generation Airbus Community to expand your own network.

Your tasks and responsibilities

Support space project teams:

- Work in Requirements management tool (Doors).
- Work in other tools (MS Office, Python, etc.).

Support Requirements Management:

- Support in the generation of specifications, certificates of conformances and verification control matrices.
- Contribute to improvements of process, methods and tools including implementation of new technologies (AI, etc.).

Optional: Support Configuration and Documentation Management:

- Maintain and update configuration documentation, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
- Support to data package reception and archiving, as well as preparation and delivery.
- Check and support in the Product Data management (PDM) Tool Windchill.

Desired skills and qualifications

- Enrolled full-time student (d/f/m) in the area of Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Physics, Computer Science, Information Technology or an equivalent field of study.
- First practical experience in the field of Microsoft Office and/or data management is desirable.
- First experience with database systems (DOORS, Windchill, JIRA, … or comparable) is desirable.
- Python programming and Data Science/AI knowledge will be very much appreciated.
- Fluent in English. Fluent in German highly appreciated.

Please upload the following documents: cover letter, CV, relevant transcripts, enrollment certificate.

Not a 100% match? No worries! Airbus supports your personal growth.

Take your career to a new level and apply online (https://www.airbus.com/en/careers) now!

As a Data Governance Specialist with a focus on Data Governance Audit and Assurance, you are part of our growing Data Governance team within our Digital Core function, where we work together on supporting the wider needs and demands from the business, transforming the way we think of data and embedding data management in our key deliveries across all areas of the energy industry. jobs.employer_name: Siemens Energy Global GmbH & Co. KG
jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

 A typical day in this role combines technical expertise, cross-functional collaboration, and a strong focus on safety in power generation and distribution plants. You coordinate functional safety and technical plant safety activities across projects, working closely with engineers, project teams, and stakeholders to develop and align technical safety concepts.

Throughout the day, you lead and moderate hazard analyses and risk assessments such as HAZID, HAZOP, QRA, and SIL studies, helping to identify potential risks and define appropriate mitigation measures. You translate these findings into clear safety requirements and support teams during the implementation and validation process to ensure compliance with relevant safety standards and guidelines, including IEC 61508/61511 and related frameworks.

Another key part of the role is verifying implemented safety functions and preparing the necessary documentation and evidence for compliance and project delivery. The position requires a structured and analytical way of working, strong communication and moderation skills, and close collaboration with multidisciplinary teams in engineering and plant operations.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Responsibility for the coordination and implementation of functional safety and technical plant safety topics in the area of power generation and distribution plants
* Development of technical safety concepts and coordination with involved stakeholders
* Leadership and moderation of hazard analyses and risk assessments (e.g., HAZID, HAZOP, QRA, SIL)
* Determination and specification of safety requirements
* Advisory support for the implementation and validation of safety requirements
* Verification of implemented safety functions and preparation of evidence documentation

What You Bring

* Degree in engineering with a background in electrical engineering, process engineering, mechanical engineering, or a comparable qualification
* Ideally, professional experience in the planning of process plants, power generation and distribution plants, or in the field of functional safety / technical plant safety
* Ideally, knowledge of common safety standards and guidelines, such as IEC 61508/61511, VDI/VDE 2180, IEC 62061, ISO 12100, and IEC 61882
